label: LÖVE (Lua)
summary: LÖVE 11.5 (LuaJIT), 2D, its own test runner inside LÖVE, smoke in an off-screen window or headless
setup_step: install LÖVE 11.5 (https://love2d.org; on Windows the zip is enough), set LOVE_BIN to its love.exe, then: python tools/dev.py doctor

adopt_hints.conf.lua: keep your love.conf settings, and copy the kit's command-line parsing (the KIT table) and its love.errorhandler into your conf.lua: without them an error in a smoke or test run waits for a key forever. See docs/ENGINE_FLOW.md > Adopting an existing project.
adopt_hints.main.lua: dev.py smoke runs `lovec . --smoke N` and expects BOOT_OK and SMOKE_DONE in the output; copy the frame counting from the kit's main.lua into your love.update, or move your game into src/game/game.lua and keep the kit's main.lua.
